selected_script.angle: Preventing broom bristle damage and handle tangling in utility room corners through vertical off-floor organization
selected_script.hook: Shoving your brooms and mops into a tight corner is literally bending and ruining the bristles.

script_record.video_001_part_01: Timeline: 0-1.5s: Close-up of bent, frayed broom bristles shoved into a dusty corner. 1.5-3s: Husband wearing a tall chef's hat and apron walks in carrying the light-gray mop holder, saying: 'Hang them up, babe!'. 3-6s: Light-gray mop holder is pressed onto smooth laundry wall; a broom is locked into a white silicone roller clip. 6-10s: First clear view of 3 brooms neatly hanging on the wall-mounted bar.
script_record.video_001_part_02: Timeline: 0-4s: Fast-cut showing the holder mounted on laundry room tile holding a mop and squeegee. 4-8s: Close-up of small towels and brushes hanging neatly from the 5 J-hooks. 8-10s: Text overlay 'Make your space cleaner and cozier.' with gentle upbeat background music.
